name: American Heritage Construction
sub: Luxury remodels, wine cellars, home theaters
founded: 1997 (Yelp) · 15 years on YellowPages · "40+ years experience" per owner copy
audience: Atherton, Portola Valley, Woodside, Menlo Park, Redwood City owners; commercial tenant improvements
description: Licensed general contractor for residential and commercial construction: room additions, wine cellars, in-home theaters, garages, cabinetry, painting, plumbing and flooring.
serviceCopy: Theaters, gyms, garages — the rooms nobody else scopes.
Millwork and finishes built in-house, not sourced late.
insight: Service area list in their own copy reads like a who's-who of the richest ZIP codes in America, and they sell it through a free page.
usps: One accountable licensed GC for design through finishes
Rare specialty scope: cellars, theaters, millwork
40 years of trade experience cited by the owner
differentiators: Neighbours in Atherton hire by portfolio; AH has none online
persona: The contractor the valley's old money keeps

reputation.note: Very thin review footprint for 25+ years of work — reputation exists offline and is not captured.

afford: Wine cellar and theater builds are six-figure scopes
Atherton/Portola Valley referral work requires credibility assets
D&B profile confirms a real, registered corporation with a named principal (Jack A Lewis)
Already accepted for Yelp Guaranteed/Birdeye tooling — spends on visibility
risk: Only 2 public reviews — needs a review-generation programme alongside the site
Gmail contact will hurt conversion; needs a domain mailbox (site project can bundle this)

art.logo: Needs a real mark — current presence is a text-only page
art.photoNote: Project photography is the entire missing asset class
